newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Jan-Aug foreign shipbuilding orders fall.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Jan-Aug foreign shipbuilding orders fall.

text.p: Foreign shipbuilding orders received by South Korean firms in the first eight months of this year fell to 2.67 million gross tonnes from 3.77 million a year earlier, the Korea Shipbuilders Association said on Friday.
Orders received in August alone totalled 563,794 gross tonnes, up from 317,900 gross tonnes in the same month of 1995, the association said.
South Korean firms had a backlog of foreign orders for 11.69 million gross tonnes at the end of August this year, down from 13.14 million a year earlier, it said.
